stories.title: Three Days to Opening Night — Final Rosters Set, Injury Cloud Builds
stories.angle: Final preparations — injury reports, roster decisions, and the mounting excitement for Monday's tripleheader.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Three days.

Knicks raise their first banner since 1973.
LeBron walks into MSG as the villain.
SGA looks for revenge at San Antonio.

Monday. October 20. NBC.

The wait is almost over. #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Injuries are piling up — Clippers, Nuggets, and Thunder all have news today.

But the Opening Night teams are healthy. Monday's tripleheader goes on as planned. #NBA

facebook.long_form:
Three days to Opening Night — and Monday, October 20, is shaping up to be one of the best single nights in recent NBA history.

Three games on NBC. Nine hours of basketball. And storylines that the league has been building toward all offseason.

The New York Knicks raise their first championship banner since 1973 before hosting LeBron James and the 76ers at 7 PM ET. The banner ceremony happens, the crowd loses its mind, and then LeBron has to actually go play basketball in that building as the visiting team.

The night opens at 3 PM ET with Paul George making his Celtics debut against the Pistons — a real Eastern Conference preview. And it closes at 9:30 PM ET with the Oklahoma City Thunder traveling to San Antonio for a Western Conference Finals rematch. The Spurs knocked out OKC in Game 7 last June. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander gets his first shot at revenge on Monday.

Despite a wave of preseason injuries around the league — the Clippers, Nuggets, and Thunder all had significant news today — the Opening Night teams are intact. Monday is happening at full strength where it matters most.

Who are you watching first? 👇 #NBA #HoopHeroes

article.headline: Three Days to Opening Night: Injuries Can't Stop the NBA's Most Anticipated Season Opener

stories.title: Roster Deadline Today — Knicks' Final Spot, League-Wide Cuts by 4 PM CT
stories.angle: Deadline day urgency — the clock is ticking for bubble players around the league.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The non-guaranteed deadline hits at 4 PM CT today.

The last decision you're watching: James Wiseman vs. Bruce Brown for the Knicks' final roster spot.

Wiseman is the frontrunner. Brown likely needs a trade. #Knicks #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
- **Posting window:** 1:00 PM ET
- **Type:** League-wide roster moves

NBA roster deadline day.

Teams have until 4 PM CT to cut to 15 + 3 two-way. Jazz, Nets, and Hawks already acted yesterday.

Three days before Opening Night. This is the last wave of cuts. #NBA

facebook.long_form:
Today is the most stressful day of the NBA calendar for bubble players. The non-guaranteed waiver deadline hits at 4 PM CT, and every team in the league must reach its final roster by then.

The biggest unresolved decision: the New York Knicks must choose between James Wiseman and Bruce Brown for their last roster spot.

Wiseman, the former No. 2 overall pick, is the frontrunner. He's 24, athletic, and fits the system as a backup big behind Mitchell Robinson. Brown, a versatile veteran wing, would likely need to find another landing spot if the Knicks pass on him.

Yesterday, the Knicks already waived three players: Drew Eubanks (torn pectoral muscle, season over), Ochai Agbaji, and Tony Bradley. Today's decision is the last one before the defending champions defend their title banner on Monday.

Around the league, the Jazz, Nets, and Hawks all made roster cuts yesterday. Expect more moves today as the clock ticks toward 4 PM CT.

For the players who don't get a call — this is where seasons end before they begin. #Knicks #NBA #HoopHeroes

stories.title: Clippers Opening Night Destroyed by Injuries — Ingram, Strus, Konan Niederhauser All Out
stories.angle: Worst-case scenario for an already-depleted Clippers squad entering the new season.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The Clippers are entering the season without:

— Brandon Ingram (Achilles/heel surgery, out indefinitely)
— Max Strus (partial plantar fascia tear)
— Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out for opener)

Darius Garland has to carry this thing. #Clippers #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Brandon Ingram hasn't played since April 29.

Heel surgery May 8. Partial Achilles tear. Coach Lue gave an encouraging update Oct. 14 — still no return date.

Clippers open vs. Sacramento Oct. 21. #Clippers #NBA

facebook.long_form:
The Los Angeles Clippers are entering the season without three rotation players — and no return date for the most important one.

Brandon Ingram has not played since April 29. He went down in Game 5 of the first-round playoff series against Toronto with a partially torn Achilles in his right heel. Heel surgery came on May 8. Coach Ty Lue gave an encouraging progress update on October 14, but the Clippers have not provided a timeline for his return. He will not play when the season opens October 21 against Sacramento.

Max Strus will also miss the opener with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot. Yanic Konan Niederhauser is out as well.

That leaves Darius Garland — acquired this offseason — as the primary offensive option, alongside rookie Keaton Wagler stepping into an expanded role. Kobe Sanders is optimistically expected to be available.

The Clippers' season is built around Ingram. Without him, they're hoping Garland can keep the team afloat until the franchise cornerstone can return. The question is when — and whether they can stay in the hunt long enough for it to matter. #Clippers #NBA #HoopHeroes

article.headline: Clippers Enter Season in Triage Mode: Ingram Out (Achilles), Strus Out, and Garland Must Carry the Load

stories.title: Thunder Lose Otega Oweh for Season — Achilles Tear Three Days Before WCF Rematch
stories.angle: The Thunder were already dealing with attrition — another hit before a massive game.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Otega Oweh has torn his right Achilles tendon and is out for the 2026-27 season.

The Thunder lose a rotation piece three days before the WCF rematch at San Antonio. #Thunder #NBA

facebook.long_form:
Tough news for the Thunder before Opening Night.

Otega Oweh has torn his right Achilles tendon and will miss the entire 2026-27 season. The Oklahoma City Thunder lose a rotation piece they were counting on, and the timing couldn't be more painful — they open Monday night at San Antonio in a Western Conference Finals rematch.

The Spurs eliminated OKC in Game 7 last June, winning on the Thunder's home court to reach the Finals. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, the two-time MVP, is healthy and ready to face San Antonio on Monday. But losing any piece of your depth before Game 1 is a blow.

The Thunder have championship aspirations. An Achilles injury is a long-haul recovery that means Oweh won't factor into any of it this year. OKC will need to find minutes somewhere else — and potentially look at the waiver wire as the season develops. #Thunder #NBA #HoopHeroes

article.headline: Otega Oweh Tears Achilles, Out for 2026-27 Season — Thunder Take Depth Hit Before WCF Rematch

stories.title: Nuggets' Strawther Knee Scare — MRI Results Awaited Before Season Opens
stories.angle: Injury concern for a deep Nuggets team — how long will Strawther be out?

x_posts.label: Post 8
x_posts.text:
Julian Strawther (left knee sprain, Oct. 14) is awaiting MRI results.

The Nuggets open Oct. 21. Nikola Jokic can carry a lot — but thin depth makes it harder.

MRI results have not been reported. #Nuggets #NBA

facebook.long_form:
The Denver Nuggets are waiting on injury news before their season begins.

Julian Strawther suffered a left knee sprain in Denver's October 14 preseason game. The Nuggets planned an MRI, and as of Saturday morning, the results have not been publicly reported. The Nuggets open the regular season on October 21.

Nikola Jokic is the kind of player who makes every teammate better and every lineup work — three MVP awards didn't happen by accident. But depth matters over an 82-game season, and losing rotation players before the opener makes the early stretch harder than it needs to be.

Denver will have clarity soon. The MRI results will determine whether Strawther can be ready for the opener or if he'll miss time early. For a team with legitimate championship aspirations, this is the injury update they're watching most closely right now. #Nuggets #NBA #HoopHeroes

article.headline: Nuggets' Strawther Awaits MRI Results — Jokic's Supporting Cast Takes Another Preseason Hit
